name: Hisame
source:
Makoto and Megumi goes on a high school graduation trip.
Due to an accident, they instead find themselves at the mansion deep in the mountains,
spending the night with a group that has been invited for mystery party.

However...
What these two encounter is a terrifying murder.
What does a series of tragedies indicate?
Can they solve the case and return alive safely?

A visual novel that describes a night of terror.

[Translated from [url=http://teamgorbons.web.fc2.com/hisame/hisame.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
诚和惠进行高中毕业旅行。
一场意外，他们却来到了深山大宅，
与受邀参加神秘派对的一群人一起过夜。

然而…
两人的遭遇，是一场恐怖的凶杀案。
一系列的悲剧说明了什么？
他们能否破案并平安归来？

一部描述恐怖之夜的视觉小说。

[翻译自[url=http://teamgorbons.web.fc2.com/hisame/hisame.html]官网[/url]]
